rationale: The agent performed order-changing actions (two cancellations and a return) without first authenticating the user beyond an email lookup and without explicit user confirmation prior to each write, violating the stated policy. It also did not address the user’s specific constraint about keeping the loved boots unless a same-size/material cheaper exchange was available; no exchange check or action was taken. Finally, it did not provide the requested final summary of how much money the user could get back today. These gaps indicate the request was not completed in line with policy.
